# SKETCH3D

> Touch-first, zero-install parametric 3D sketch modeler for iPad and desktop web, engineered for the Bambu Lab A1 3D printer.

SKETCH3D enables users to sketch 2D closed profiles, insert precision metric screw holes (M2, M3, M4, M5 with FDM clearance), add polygonal cutouts, and apply real-time Grasshopper-style parametric modifiers (Extrusion up to 256 mm, Bevel, Twist) entirely in the browser. Models export directly as watertight, slicer-ready binary `.STL` files aligned with the Bambu Lab A1 build plate.

## Target Hardware
- **Printer**: Bambu Lab A1
- **Build Volume**: 256 × 256 × 256 mm
- **Nozzle**: Standard 0.4 mm hardened/stainless steel
- **Bed**: Textured PEI Plate
- **Export Format**: Binary STL with printer Z-up coordinate transformation `(X, -Z, Y)`

## Key Capabilities
- **2D Sketching**: Touch & mouse drawing with configurable grid snap (1 mm, 5 mm, 10 mm, Off), vertex dragging, and edge-point insertion.
- **Metric Screw Holes**: Pre-calibrated M2 (2.2 mm), M3 (3.2 mm), M4 (4.2 mm), and M5 (5.2 mm) diameter holes with +0.2 mm FDM clearance.
- **Live Edge Dimensioning**: Millimeter dimensions rendered along active sketch segments.
- **Parametric 3D Modifiers**: Live Z-axis extrusion (1–256 mm), multi-segment beveling (0–4 mm), and axial twist deformation (0–180°).
- **Printability Guardrails**: Real-time validation warning if dimensions exceed the 256 mm bed or if thickness drops below 1.2 mm for reliable FDM printing.
- **Project Persistence**: Client-side JSON project save and load for versioning and iterative design.
- **Zero Backend**: 100% client-side HTML5 Canvas, WebGL (Three.js), and vanilla JavaScript.

## Documentation & Links
- [Live Web Application](https://iocfinc.github.io/sketch3d/): Main browser-based 3D modeler.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/iocfinc/sketch3d): Source code, issues, and releases.
- [Bambu Lab A1 Tech Specs](https://bambulab.com/en/a1/tech-specs): Target 3D printer hardware specifications.
